tasks.analysis: Variations in the Earth's temperature over time can be explained by changes in the energy absorbed by the Earth from the Sun. The variation in the Earth's seasons occurs because the Earth is closest to and farthest from the Sun at different times of the year. However, seasonal changes do not noticeably change the overall temperature of the Earth over short periods of time.
